title: Why did Elon Musk buy Twitter? | Future of Twitter | Shivanshu Agrawal
description:
Twitter, not Tesla made Elon Musk the richest man in the world. 

Elon Musk just bought Twitter for 44 Billion USD and in this video, I'll cover:
1. Why did Elon Musk buy Twitter
2. How Elon Musk uses Twitter to grow his personal wealth and his companies.
3. What changes can we expect in Twitter after the deal (Future of Twitter)

Shivanshu Agrawal AKA Marketing Shivanshu
